story.text: At Uppercross, Anne finds that nobody gives Kellynch a thought. She becomes everyone’s {CONFIDANTE}: Mary {GRUMBLES} about the Musgroves, and the Musgroves about Mary’s {SPOILED} boys. In the evenings Anne plays for the young ones to dance. “Well done, Miss Anne!” they say {POLITELY}, and nobody listens. Then the Crofts come to Kellynch, and Mrs. Croft’s {BROTHER} is expected.
story.caption: “Well done, Miss Anne!”
